big_case.notes: Emergency stay over whether party committees' coordinated buys get the lowest-unit-charge rate for the 2026 general-election window, with the Solicitor General backing the applicants against a divided Fourth Circuit; disposed of by per curiam opinion with a noted Jackson dissent and an evident cert vehicle on Hobbs Act finality / §315(b). High political salience and nationwide pricing effect for one election cycle, but a statutory-administrative question rather than a constitutional one, and a stay rather than a merits judgment.
